info.name: Parent Invite API Collection (Phase 4)

request.description: Needs an already-activated teacher account for {{branch_id}} (see postman_teacher_onboarding_collection.json).

Downloads a pre-formatted Excel (.xlsx) template for bulk parent invites.
Columns: student_name, class, grade, parent_name, parent_email, parent_mobile, relationship_type.
'grade' is the section label (e.g. "A") despite the name — see docs/API_V4.0_PARENT_ONBOARDING.md.
Requires teacher JWT + chain_id header.

exec: console.log('Now copy the raw token from the auth-service console log line: [DEV] parent raw invite token: ...');

header.description: Required — TenantDB middleware uses this to load the correct DB pool.

request.description:
Creates parents.student + student_enrollment for the given class/section (one invite always covers exactly one student), then either:
- sends a brand-new invite (status: "invited"), or
- if the parent contact already has an active account (another child already onboarded), links this student directly to it — no invite needed (status: "linked_to_existing_parent").

Run this request twice with the same parent_email/parent_mobile but a different student_name (after completing Phase 5 for the first) to see the second case.

formdata.description: CSV file with header row: student_name,class,grade,parent_name,parent_email,parent_mobile,relationship_type — attach your .csv file here

request.description:
Upload a CSV file to bulk-invite parents. One row = one student = one invite.
Expected CSV format (first row is header):
  student_name,class,grade,parent_name,parent_email,parent_mobile,relationship_type
  Kavin Raj,Class 6,A,Suresh Raj,suresh.raj@example.com,+919876500011,Father
  Meena Raj,Class 3,B,Suresh Raj,suresh.raj@example.com,+919876500011,Father

class/grade/relationship_type are resolved by name against masters.classes/masters.sections/masters.relationship_type (case-insensitive) — an unmatched name fails just that row, not the whole upload.
Two rows sharing the same parent contact only collapse into one account if the first has already completed Phase 5 activation by the time the second is invited — otherwise each gets its own separate invite/link.

Returns: total, sent_count, failed_count with per-row details.

formdata.description: Excel file (.xlsx) with header row on first sheet: student_name, class, grade, parent_name, parent_email, parent_mobile, relationship_type — attach your .xlsx file here

request.description:
Upload an Excel (.xlsx) file to bulk-invite parents. First sheet is used, first row must be the header.
Same name-resolution and sibling-merging behavior as the CSV variant above.

Returns: total, sent_count, failed_count with per-row error details.
